CONSENT.TITLE: Join {{clinic}}?
CONSENT.INTRO: {{admin}} invited you to join {{clinic}} on ClinicWell. Please read what joining means before you accept.
CONSENT.ACCOUNT: You keep your own account, login, and patients. Neither you nor the clinic can delete the other's account.
CONSENT.LIMITS: While you are a member, the clinic covers your plan limits.
CONSENT.HISTORY: While you are a member, only you can delete records, and a patient is deleted only when the clinic approves your request. You and the clinic can see a history of the changes made to your patients and their records, kept until 90 days after the membership ends.
CONSENT.COPY: When your membership ends, the clinic may keep a copy of the patients added to your account while you were a member, in the clinic admin's account or another member's: their profile, dental chart, notes, all appointments (including future ones), treatments, payments, and files.
CONSENT.LEAVING: Either side can end the membership. It takes effect at the end of the notice period, and the clinic can also end it at once.
CONSENT.OWN_PLAN: Joining does not cancel a plan you pay for yourself. If you no longer need it, cancel it in the billing portal on the Plans page.
CONSENT.AGREE: I have read these terms and agree to them.
